features.rationale: Turbulent-to-wall time-scale ratio separating near-wall versus outer/free-shear where SST anisotropy error differs.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless by L-T scaling (all ratios L^2/T^3 over L^2/T^3 and L/T^2 over L/T^2); finite: denominators include eps or gradp+(Snorm+omega)*sqrt(k) so zero only at exact wall face, cell-center training points >99% finite; bounded forms preserve ordering under x/(|x|+median) mapping; wall behavior finite (0 in attached, mid-range in shear layer); distinct from f_wall (wall vs outer) and not collinear with I1/I2; drop f_apg (unused, gain 0, Umag singularity at reattachment) and f_curv (gain -0.033 harmful, replaced by more robust APG/accel markers) to avoid overfit on bumps/CD channel.

features.name: f_apg2
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs turbulence production/dissipation scale, positive in APG/deceleration upstream of separation and negative in FPG without Umag singularity.

features.name: f_neq
features.rationale: Bounded non-equilibrium production vs dissipation, high in separated shear layers where production far exceeds dissipation.

features.name: f_acc
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs pressure plus turbulent/shear forces, marks strong acceleration/curvature over bump crest and diffuser throat vs pressure-dominated separation.

features: gradp_mag * d / (k + gradp_mag * d + eps / (Snorm + omega))

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless by construction (verified L-T scaling) and wall-safe: denominators contain omega>0 or eps>0 so no 0/0 at wall where Umag=k=d=0; bounded or regularized forms avoid Umag singularities in separation; ordering only matters due to median rescaling. Overlap risk is low: f_curv is signed rotation-strain difference (curvature) distinct from I1/I2 magnitudes, f_pgd is Clauser-like wall-weighted pressure force vs k (APG/separation location) distinct from signed f_apg2 being dropped, f_advk is signed k-advection vs production-dissipation (non-equilibrium transport/reattachment) distinct from f_neq being dropped; f_wall/f_acc retained as they have positive heldout_gain.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Signed curvature/rotation dominance: positive in rotation-dominated separation bubble cores and curved shear layers, negative in strain-dominated attached boundary layers and stagnation.

features.name: f_pgd
features.formula: gradp_mag * d / (k + gradp_mag * d + eps / (Snorm + omega))
features.rationale: Clauser-like wall-weighted pressure-gradient vs turbulent energy scale, high in APG upstream of separation and low in free shear and FPG acceleration.

features.name: f_advk
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs production-dissipation, marks non-equilibrium transport into separation bubbles and reattachment where advection balances local production.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless (L-T scaling invariant): f_noneq L2/T3 over L2/T3; f_apg L2/T3 over L2/T3; f_shear 1/T over 1/T. Finite: f_shear denom omega>0 always finite; f_apg denom includes eps>0 off-wall finite; f_noneq denom eps+|Pk|>0 off-wall, only 0/0 if k=eps=Pk=0 at wall (<1% points). Ordering distinct from kept f_wall (wall distance) and f_curv (W-S): noneq targets Pk/eps equilibrium, apg signed APG/FPG vs turbulence, shear targets shear-timescale vs omega. Drop f_acc,f_pgd,f_advk (gain<=0, 0 terms) to avoid search dilution/overfit; keep f_wall,f_curv (positive gain). No log/exp blowup, no d in denominator alone.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Bounded production-to-dissipation non-equilibrium sensor, high (>0.5) in separating shear layers where Pk>>eps and negative where destruction dominates.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG vs turbulence+dissipation scale, positive in APG deceleration upstream of separation and negative in FPG acceleration over bump crest/throat.

features.name: f_shear
features.rationale: Shear-to-turbulence time-scale ratio marking strong non-equilibrium strained shear layers and throat acceleration vs weak-shear freestream and rotation cores.

features: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag * Snorm + Umag * omega + gradp_mag)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed formulas checked dimensionless under velocity*2 length*3: f_apg2 [L2/T3]/[L2/T3], f_accel [L/T2]/[L/T2], f_aniso [L2/T2]/[L2/T2]. Finite by construction: denominators contain eps>0 or gradp_mag/Umag*omega>0, so >0 on >99% points; bounded in (-1,1) or (0,1) so not constant and compatible with x/(|x|+median) mapping. Overlap risk: f_apg2 replaces f_apg with wall-convection scale k*Umag/d instead of (Snorm+omega)*k to better isolate near-wall APG separation onset on bumps; f_accel is only acceleration sensor; f_aniso uses eps/(Snorm+omega)>0 stabilizer to avoid 0/0 at wall. Drop all 5 active (gain<=0, 3 unused) to stop heldout overfit; risk is loss of current train fit using f_wall/f_shear, mitigated because new features cover same wall/shear/APG physics with better conditioning and boundedness for bump_h26/h38 worst heldout.

features.name: f_apg2
features.rationale: Signed APG vs wall-convection plus dissipation scale, positive in APG deceleration upstream of bump separation and negative in FPG acceleration over crest.

features.name: f_accel
features.formula: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag * Snorm + Umag * omega + gradp_mag)
features.rationale: Bounded acceleration versus shear-turbulence plus pressure-force scale marking throat/crest acceleration versus separation-bubble deceleration.

features.name: f_aniso
features.rationale: Relative baseline anisotropy magnitude marking separated shear layers and reattachment where SST stress error is largest versus isotropic freestream.
